main.description: A queued share intent — created when the owner tries to share a document with a recipient who hasn't set up Opake yet (no publicKey/self record). The daemon retries periodically until the recipient signs up or the record expires (7 days). On success, a grant record is created and this record is deleted.

opakeVersion.description: Schema version for the at.opake.* namespace.

document.description: AT URI of the document to share.

recipient.description: Handle or DID of the intended recipient, as the user entered it.

encryptedMetadata.description: Encrypted share metadata (permissions, note). Encrypted with the document's content key so it can be decrypted at retry time.
